title: Regular Polygons
description: Regular pentagon, hexagon, and a general n-sided polygon, each buildable by 2-3 classical methods on the same side length via a live method switcher — pentagon by 54° angle, two circles and an arc, or three arcs; hexagon by 60° lines or compass alone; any polygon from 3 to 12 sides by semicircle division or perpendicular bisector — animated step by step, then set up as a textbook problem to verify.
